time_basis: Oracle localdatetime; timezone and clock correspondence unconfirmed
full_bin_definition: All eight calendar 15min cells occupied; descriptive coverage, not an admission rule
adjacent_pairs: Consecutive accepted observations inside the same 2h bin, including gaps; no cross-bin pairs
quantiles: pandas linear empirical quantiles, own-sensor defined cells/pairs only; no confidence intervals
insufficient: n<2: all variation measures NaN; empty means NaN, never zero fill

captions.intrabin_2h_distributions: I show per-sensor empirical distributions of observed within-bin CO₂ range and maximum absolute deviation from the own-sensor mean. Quantiles are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
captions.intrabin_2h_adjacent_distributions: I include every adjacent accepted pair within a 2 h bin, including pairs spanning missing cells; I retain the actual elapsed time. Changes are not measurements of physical process speed.
captions.example_01: I compare accepted CO₂ observations with each sensor’s own 2 h mean. Lines join only adjacent occupied 15 min cells; grey spans show missing cells. Selection: GMM222 996: earliest incomplete bin across three sensors; lowest sensor ID tie

limitations: Observed variability is not proof of physical significance or transport time
A 2h mean can retain an excursion contribution but loses its internal shape
Missing accepted points and unobserved sub-15min behavior remain unknown
No Fourier calculation, new quality threshold, interpolation, air mask or physical model
